page: OVHcloud rtx5000-84 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The underlying host platform features an Intel Xeon W-3235 processor based on the x86_64 architecture, configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 virtual CPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz with no hyperthreading enabled. The system includes 84 GB of system memory, yielding 5.25 GB per core, and is bundled with a 400 GB local SSD alongside a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. Public IPv4 connectivity is not bundled by default.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by three dedicated NVIDIA Turing Quadro RTX 5000 GPUs, offering a combined pool of 48 GB of GDDR6 VRAM across 16 GB individual buffers. This multi-GPU arrangement reflects strong benchmark performance during machine learning workloads. In large language model evaluation, prompt processing reaches 8884.89 tokens per second for small 135M models, 1827.36 tokens per second for medium 7B models, and 220.48 tokens per second for large 70B models, placing the instance in the top tier of inference efficiency across these evaluations.

General system benchmarks place the processor within average performance bands, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 8459.0 and a multi-core stress-ng result of 22027.17. Memory subsystem performance shows contrast: while cached small-block read operations attain 990.44 GB/sec and the PassMark memory evaluation ranks in the upper quartile, uncached large-block write throughput drops to 25.38 GB/sec. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression settles within the bottom quartile at 23.78 GB/sec.

With 48 GB of aggregate VRAM across three discrete graphics processors, the rtx5000-84 presents cost-effective compute density for parallelized AI inference, multi-stream video transcode pipelines, GPU-accelerated ray tracing, and batch image processing. The limited local storage footprint of 400 GB and lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses indicate that environments handling high-volume persistent data or direct ingress routing benefit from external object storage and dedicated network provisioning.
description: OVHcloud rtx5000-84 is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel computing, AI inference, and graphic workloads. Powered by a 16-core Intel Xeon W-3235 processor running at 3.3 GHz with dedicated x86_64 cores, the configuration supplies 84 GB of RAM, a 400 GB local SSD, and 10 Gbps network bandwidth. Acceleration is driven by three NVIDIA Turing Quadro RTX 5000 GPUs providing an aggregate 48 GB of VRAM. Benchmark results show leading LLM prompt processing capabilities, reaching 1827.36 tokens per second on 7B models and top-tier metrics on 70B architectures. While CPU compute metrics and memory read cache show solid mid-to-high percentile stability, uncached write memory bandwidth sits in lower quartiles. The instance delivers dense GPU resources for machine learning model serving, rendering, and computer vision tasks.
